beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Student forms now explain that first and last names should match Pathways, while preferred names can be anything.
• Sample comparison controls are clearer, with the option to delete either sample.

Fixes:
• Preferred names now appear in the verification window, reopened sample headers, progress grid, and exception paperwork. Queued samples use the current preferred name when opened.
• Searching the progress grid now finds students by their preferred names.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
